references.text: The Levites were given as a gift to Aaron and his sons from the Israelites to serve in the sanctuary.
The Lord took the Levites from the Israelites instead of all the firstborn, and they belong to him.
The Levites were set apart from the Israelites and given as a gift to the Lord to serve in the tabernacle.
The Levites were given as a gift to Aaron and his sons to perform service in the tent of meeting.
The Levites were appointed to serve at the tabernacle of the testimony and carry out its duties.
The tribe of Levi was chosen for special service to the Lord.
The tribe of Levi was set apart to carry the ark of the covenant, stand before the Lord, and serve him.
Christ gave gifts to people for service in the church, just as the Levites were given as gifts for service in the sanctuary.
